name: [otel demo] product-catalog error rate (${ENV_NAME})
message: Error rate on product-catalog is above 5% over 10 minutes, from the OTel-derived trace metrics. It fires all the time on purpose: the scheduler holds productCatalogFailure on for one product (OLJCESPC7Z), about 7.6% of lookups, so a presenter always has an open alert outside the :30 to :45 window. No notification targets on purpose.
